name: Fusuisaurus
sum: Fusuisaurus is a very large basal titanosauriform from the Early Cretaceous Xinlong Formation of Guangxi, China, known from fragmentary postcranial remains.
wsnote: Estimate by G. S. Paul quoted by the Wikipedia revision; the humerus is 183.5 cm long.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; a left ilium, left pubis, anterior caudals, most dorsal ribs and the distal end of the left femur found in 2001.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Mo et al. 2006

sources.text: Mo, Jinyou; Wang, Wei; Huang, Zhitao; Huang, Xin; Xu, Xing 2006. A Basal Titanosauriform from the Early Cretaceous of Guangxi, China. Acta Geologica Sinica 80(4): 486–489. doi:10.1111/j.1755-6724.2006.tb00267.x
